project_type: React Native library — a single npm package (@applens/react-native v0.3.2). NOT a monorepo. Ships RN source under src/ plus Node-only CLI entry points under src/ai/*.js. Example/ is a separate RN app used for manual testing.
language: TypeScript (strict). RN components are .tsx; Node CLI wrappers are plain .js.
build_system: tsc. tsconfig.json has noEmit:true for type-check; tsconfig.build.json extends it with noEmit:false, outDir:dist, rootDir:src, declaration:true, and include ['src/**/*.ts','src/**/*.tsx','src/**/*.js']. Because include is src/**, any new src/agent/** compiles automatically with no config change — confirm, do not re-architect. module:commonjs, moduleResolution:node, target:esnext, types:['node'], @types/node ^18 is a devDependency.
test_framework: No root test framework exists today (only Example/ uses jest for the RN app). FileAccess tests MUST use Node's built-in node:test runner (no new dependency). Compile first, then run the compiled test with `node --test`.
build_command: npm run build  (tsc -p tsconfig.build.json). Type-check gate: npm run type-check (tsc --noEmit).
test_command: Add root script "test:agent": "node --test dist/agent/workspace/" and run `npm run build && npm run test:agent`. There is no pre-existing test command at the package root.
verification_instructions: 1) npm run type-check must be clean. 2) npm run build must emit dist/ai/index-agent.js and dist/agent/** and must NOT leak any src/agent export into the RN barrel (dist/index.js / dist/index.d.ts) — only AgentClient and shared protocol TYPES may appear. 3) npm run build && npm run test:agent — the FileAccess node:test cases pass (../ escape rejected, absolute rejected, symlink-escape rejected, in-workspace read ok, deny-list enforced, size cap enforced). 4) Documented manual e2e: npx applens-agent --project . against Example/, pair from a tiny WS client, ask a question that forces a read_file + a get_console_logs round-trip, confirm a patch message returns and applens-agent-report.md is appended. 5) No-regression: with no agent running / aiAgentURL unset, the AI tab behaves exactly as today.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. The agent writes applens-agent-report.md to the TARGET project root at runtime (its own report — the ONLY allowed write; it is not a repo artifact and should not be committed). dist/ is produced by build and is in .gitignore/npm files already (dist is in package.json "files").
environment_constraints: src/agent/** is Node-only (imports node:fs and ws) and must NEVER be importable into the RN bundle — enforce by exporting ONLY src/agent-client/** and shared protocol TYPES from src/index.ts, with the bin wrapper as the sole entry into src/agent/**. The device uses the RN global WebSocket (no new RN dependency); only the Node agent uses the `ws` package. Server binds 127.0.0.1 by default; 0.0.0.0 only with an explicit --host flag plus a printed LAN-exposure warning. AIProvider has NO native function-calling, so the loop is prompt-driven JSON tool-calls with an 8-round cap.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md present. Match existing conventions: heavy JSDoc on exported symbols, strict TypeScript, no new runtime deps beyond `ws` (pin to a current stable release in dependencies). bin wrappers mirror src/ai/index-project-ast.js (try require the compiled module from dist, fall back to ts-node). package.json scripts: type-check, build, clean, prepare(=build). Do NOT add apply_patch, command execution, AST tools, native function-calling, monorepo split, or apply/reject buttons — all explicitly out of scope.
key_patterns: AIProvider: createAIProvider(config) returns an AIProvider; OpenAIProvider.chatStream(messages, context, onToken) streams text deltas and returns {text, usage}. AITab.tsx streams via streamBufferRef + scheduleFlush/flushStream (requestAnimationFrame batching) into a pre-created assistant bubble; it reuses markdownStyles and a Copy button (copyToClipboard). AppLens.getStorage() returns AppLensStorage with getNetworkRequests():NetworkRequest[] and getLogs():LogEntry[] (values already redacted at capture). AppLens.getConfig() returns a read-only config copy. Addressing rules (iOS sim 127.0.0.1, Android emu 10.0.2.2, physical device LAN IP) mirror the LM Studio help text in OpenAIProvider.buildConnectionHelp. index-project-ast.js wrapper pattern: require compiled dist module with a ts-node transpileOnly fallback and clear usage/error messages.

directory_structure: src/core (AppLens, AppLensConfig, provider/UI), src/ai (AIProvider/OpenAIProvider/LocalAIProvider, KnowledgeGraph, ContextEngine, index-project*.js bin wrappers), src/storage (AppLensStorage), src/tabs (AITab.tsx and others), src/types (AITypes/NetworkTypes/LogTypes/etc.), src/components, src/utils (redact). NEW: src/agent/** (Node-only: cli.ts, server.ts, protocol.ts, workspace/, tools/, loop/) and src/agent-client/** (RN-safe: AgentClient.ts). Example/ is a standalone RN app for manual smoke testing.
